title: BPW-2026-0601
text:
[BUREAU OF ENGINEERING]
BPW-2026-0601
CD ALL
REQUEST FOR AUTHORIZATION – APPROVE ABOVE GROUND FACILITY VARIANCES
Recommending the Board:
AUTHORIZE the City Engineer to act on behalf of the Board to review and approve Above Ground Facility (AGF) Volume and Height Threshold Variance on AGFs between 36 cubic feet and 80 cubic feet in volume, and up to 30 feet in height for monopoles only, to the satisfaction of the City Engineer;
AUTHORIZE the City Engineer to approve AGF Density Threshold on behalf of the Board for AGFs not to exceed nine per City of Los Angeles block to the satisfaction of the City Engineer;
AUTHORIZE the City Engineer to provide a Hardship Waiver for the installation of AGFs above grade in areas that require the installation below grade upon receiving no objections from the Department of City Planning; and
AUTHORIZE the City Engineer to conditionally issue construction permits for AGFs that have met all Los Angeles Municipal Code requirements but have open appeals in situations that the AGF is a state mandated safety retrofit and subject to removal if Board later grants the appeal.
summary: Lets the City Engineer approve variances to above-ground facility volume, height and density limits, grant hardship waivers, and conditionally issue permits for facilities with open appeals when they are state-mandated safety retrofits.

details.action: approval of above ground facility variances
